lean.statement: theorem scalarTensorTowerComparison_exists : ∃ μ : ∀ {R S : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r}} (a : R ⟶ S), ScalarHomTensorComparison M a, (∀ {R S T : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r}} (a : R ⟶ S) (b : S ⟶ T) (K : DerivedCategory (scalarModules J R)) (N : DerivedCategory (scalarModules J T)), (scalarHomCanonicalIso M (a ≫ b) (μ (a ≫ b))).hom.app (op K, N) ≫ (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J R).map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 (op K)) ((scalarHomRestrictionComp.{c, v, r, w} a b).hom.app N)) = (scalarHomRestrictionComp.{c, v, r, w} a b).hom.app ((derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J T).obj (op ((M.scalar (a ≫ b)).derived.obj K), N)) ≫ (scalarDerivedRestriction a).map ((scalarDerivedRestriction b).map ((derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J T).map (Prod.mkHom ((scalarHomExtensionComp M a b).hom.app K).op (𝟙 N)))) ≫ (scalarDerivedRestriction a).map ((scalarHomCanonicalIso M b (μ b)).hom.app (op ((M.scalar a).derived.obj K), N)) ≫ (scalarHomCanonicalIso M a (μ a)).hom.app (op K, (scalarDerivedRestriction b).obj N)) ∧ (∀ (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r}) (K N : DerivedCategory (scalarModules J R)), (scalarHomCanonicalIso M (𝟙 R) (μ (𝟙 R))).hom.app (op K, N) ≫ (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J R).map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 (op K)) ((scalarHomRestrictionId.{c, v, r, w} R).hom.app N)) = (scalarHomRestrictionId.{c, v, r, w} R).hom.app ((derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J R).obj (op ((M.scalar (𝟙 R)).derived.obj K), N)) ≫ (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J R).map (Prod.mkHom ((scalarHomExtensionId M R).inv.app K).op (𝟙 N)))
